input: Contact HR about unused vacation days expiring

gold.taskTitle: Contact HR About Expiring Unused Vacation Days
gold.taskDescription: Reach out to HR to address unused vacation days that are at risk of expiring.

questions.title: When exactly do your unused vacation days expire?
questions.description: Identify the specific expiration date or deadline for the unused vacation days.

questions.title: How many unused vacation days are at stake?
questions.description: Determine the number of vacation days that could expire.

questions.title: What outcome do you want from HR?
questions.description: Clarify the desired result, such as an extension, payout, carryover approval, or just information.

questions.title: How do you prefer to contact HR for this?
questions.description: Identify the preferred communication method, such as email, phone, or an HR portal.

questions.title: Do you have a specific HR contact person already?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a named HR representative or needs to find the right contact first.

questions.title: Has your company shared any policy on vacation day expiry?
questions.description: Check whether the user has already reviewed relevant company policy documents.

questions.title: By when do you need to complete this contact?
questions.description: Establish a personal deadline or urgency level for reaching out to HR.
